name: io.github.troybrandonc-bit/omem
title: OMEM
description: Memory for AI agents that tracks beliefs over time and surfaces contradictions

environmentVariables.name: OMEM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from the OMEM server. It is printed on first run of `omem-server`.

environmentVariables.name: OMEM_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: Project id to read and write memory in, also printed on first run.

environmentVariables.name: OMEM_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: The agent whose memory this process reads and writes. Fixed here rather than passed as a tool argument, so the model cannot act as a different agent.

environmentVariables.name: OMEM_USER
environmentVariables.description: The end user this process is acting for. Also fixed here, not a tool argument. Leave unset and no user-scoped memory is visible.
